answer: Jade ledger binding. Each agent identity commits a one-time, publicly auditable artifact (a unique signed state digest) into an append-only ledger; duplicate derivations collapse to the same entry. Enforcement: any clone reusing or cheaply regenerating a digest must post a verification deposit that is forfeited on collision, so the marginal clone pays a full deposit plus audit fee for zero added capacity. The zenith of each epoch reconciles ledger roots; an echo of any prior digest is rejected outright. Net cost per clone stays strictly above expected gain.
